passive.name: Sunlight
passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
primaryAbilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Leona's next Attack <status>Stuns</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }}</magicDamage> magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Eclipse
primaryAbilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by {{ flatdamagereduction }} and gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist for {{ armormrduration }} seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional {{ armormrduration }} seconds.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Zenith Blade
primaryAbilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The last champion struck will be <status>Rooted</status> for {{ rootduration }} seconds and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Solar Flare
primaryAbilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing <magicDamage>{{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are <status>Stunned</status> instead of <status>Slowed</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
